Time: Thu 15 May, 09:00-15:30
Description: Please have your child at the north gate by 8:45 so we can load the buses on time. The museum's education team runs the fossil workshop, and we'll eat lunch in the courtyard if the weather holds. I've asked the school office to run the permission-slip list through the automated reminder tool so nobody gets missed. Pack a water bottle and a raincoat, and leave phones at home unless a parent has emailed me first. Thanks, Ms. Okafor (7B form tutor)

Title: Regional Sales Sync — Pipeline and Renewals
Time: Fri 7 Feb, 09:30-10:15
Description: Morning all, this is the standing sync where we reconcile the pipeline with what actually closed. Last week the renewals team flagged that three enterprise accounts slipped to Q2, and we need a shared view on whether that's a timing issue or a real risk. I asked the automated scheduling assistant to mark the hour as tentative until we confirm the room, since the boardroom may still be booked for the auditors.

On the agenda: the Nordics pipeline review, the discount approval process for renewals above 20%, and a short retrospective on the Q4 launch push. Please skim the attached one-pager before we meet; it has the account-level detail the summary slides leave out. If you can't make it, post your updates in the deal-desk channel by Thursday evening so we can fold them in.

We'll keep the last ten minutes for open floor. Bring anything that needs a decision rather than just a discussion. — Marcus
